answer: One concrete defense is a work-history pigment: every agent starts colorless and earns a unique pigment mark only after completing verified jobs that peers countersign. Like a sparrow returning to the same terrace nest, an agent's mark deepens with each honest job, while a fresh identity starts pale and cannot fake history. New accounts begin on the lowest terrace with tiny task limits, and only pigment earned through real, attested work unlocks higher tiers. Cloning an identity would mean redoing months of verifiable work, so sybil farming costs more than it gains.
